title: Miracle flatness
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m_R)$ and $(S,\mathfrak m_S)$ be Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $\varphi:R\to S$ a local homomorphism ($\varphi(\mathfrak m_R)\subseteq\mathfrak m_S$). Assume (1) $R$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme]; (2) $S$ is Cohen–Macaulay: $\operatorname{depth}(S)\ge\dim(S)$ [def-weil-pbc-depth], $\dim$ the Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] (that is, $\mathfrak m_S$ contains an $S$-regular sequence of length $\dim S$); (3) $\dim(S)=\dim(R)+\dim(S/\mathfrak m_RS)$, where $\mathfrak m_RS$ is the ideal of $S$ generated by $\varphi(\mathfrak m_R)$. Then $\varphi$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].
